events.name: 2026 NBA Finals (completed) — reigning champion
events.notes: The New York Knicks beat the San Antonio Spurs 4-1 to win the 2026 title, their first since 1973 (third overall); Jalen Brunson was Finals MVP. Game 4 featured a 29-point Knicks comeback won on an OG Anunoby tip-in with 1.2 seconds left, and the Knicks closed it out 94-90 in Game 5. The Spurs reached the Finals by beating the Oklahoma City Thunder in the 2026 Western Conference Finals. The Knicks enter 2026-27 as defending champions.

events.name: Nike 'Specter' uniforms reveal (End of Ordinary fashion show)
events.notes: Nike and the NBA unveiled new 'Specter' uniforms for eight historic franchises (Celtics, Lakers, Warriors, Knicks, 76ers, Kings, Pistons, Hawks) at Nike's 'End of Ordinary' fashion show, with a merchandise collection released at the same time. They will be worn in select 2026-27 games alongside the usual Association, Icon, Statement and City Edition uniforms. Which games they are worn in was not captured.

events.name: Preseason start
events.notes: The Toronto Raptors and Miami Heat open the preseason on Saturday Oct 3, the first NBA preseason game in Quebec City. The preseason includes all 30 teams, with games in the U.S., Canada, China and Hawaii. ESPN's national preseason games are Kings at Lakers (Oct 8), Spurs at Suns (Oct 10), Magic at Cavaliers and Bulls at Nuggets (Oct 11), and Nuggets at Lakers (Oct 16).

events.name: Opening night (regular season tips off)
events.location: Detroit; New York (Madison Square Garden); San Antonio
events.notes: Tuesday tripleheader on NBC: Boston Celtics at Detroit Pistons (the East's two best 2025-26 regular-season teams), Philadelphia 76ers at New York Knicks (the Knicks start their title defense against a new-look Sixers team that now has LeBron James and, per Dunkest, Jaylen Brown), and Oklahoma City Thunder at San Antonio Spurs (a rematch of the 2026 West finals). The reported tip times are 3:00, 7:00 and 9:30 p.m. ET. The 3:00 p.m. Celtics-Pistons time is unusual for a Tuesday, so re-check it before quoting exact times.

events.name: Emirates NBA Cup 2026 — group play (Cup Nights)
events.notes: This is the fourth edition of the Cup. Group play runs every Friday from Oct 30 through Nov 27, plus extra Cup Nights on Tuesday Nov 24 and Wednesday Nov 25 (Thanksgiving week). Each team plays the four other teams in its group once, and the six group winners plus the best second-place team in each conference advance. The groups were seeded from the 2025-26 standings. East A: Pistons, Raptors, Magic, Bucks, Nets. East B: Knicks, Cavaliers, 76ers, Heat, Pacers. East C: Celtics, Hawks, Hornets, Bulls, Wizards. West A: Nuggets, Rockets, Suns, Mavericks, Jazz. West B: Thunder, Timberwolves, Clippers, Pelicans, Grizzlies. West C is inferred from the remaining teams rather than read directly: Spurs, Lakers, Warriors, Trail Blazers, Kings. Opening Cup night (Oct 30): Hornets at Wizards, 76ers at Pacers, Nets at Raptors, Hawks at Celtics, Grizzlies at Timberwolves, Mavericks at Suns, Lakers at Spurs, Nuggets at Jazz, Pelicans at Clippers, Warriors at Trail Blazers.

events.name: Emirates NBA Cup 2026 — quarterfinals
events.notes: Single-game quarterfinals. All knockout games (quarterfinals, semifinals and the championship) stream on Amazon Prime Video.

events.name: Emirates NBA Cup 2026 — semifinals
events.location: Home arenas of the higher-seeded teams (no neutral site)
events.notes: This is new for 2026: the semifinals are played in the higher seed's home market instead of at the neutral Las Vegas site used from 2023 to 2025. They stream on Prime Video.

events.name: Emirates NBA Cup 2026 — championship
events.notes: The final is on Friday Dec 11 at Butler's historic Hinkle Fieldhouse, moving away from T-Mobile Arena in Las Vegas (the 2023-2025 site). It streams on Prime Video. In prior editions the final was the only Cup game that did not count in regular-season standings; that rule was not re-checked for 2026.

events.name: Christmas Day games
events.location: New York; Boston; Los Angeles; Minneapolis; San Francisco
events.notes: Friday, five games on ESPN/ABC: San Antonio Spurs at New York Knicks at noon ET (the first meeting since the 2026 Finals), Miami Heat at Boston Celtics at 2:30, Philadelphia 76ers at Los Angeles Lakers at 5:00 (new 76er LeBron James returns to face the Lakers), Oklahoma City Thunder at Minnesota Timberwolves at 8:00, and Denver Nuggets at Golden State Warriors at 10:30. NBC/Peacock also airs 'Holiday Hoops' games in late December.

events.name: MLK Day games
events.notes: The 41st NBA MLK Day falls on Monday Jan 18, with NBC/Peacock's second annual MLK Day quadrupleheader starting at noon ET: Detroit Pistons at Cleveland Cavaliers at noon (a rematch of a 2026 East semifinal), Philadelphia 76ers at Atlanta Hawks at 2:30 (Atlanta's traditional MLK Day home game, featuring LeBron James), Minnesota Timberwolves at New York Knicks at 5:00 (the defending champions host Anthony Edwards), and Houston Rockets vs. Memphis Grizzlies in the nightcap. The home team and tip time for Rockets-Grizzlies were not confirmed.

events.name: NBA Rivals Week / league themed weeks
events.notes: Not found in the 2026-27 schedule coverage searched on 2026-10-07. A January 'NBA Rivals Week' ran in 2024-25, but nothing confirmed or ruled out a 2026-27 edition.

events.name: Trade deadline
events.notes: Thursday, Feb 11, 2027.

events.name: Presidents' Day games
events.notes: NBC/Peacock's first-ever Presidents' Day quadrupleheader on Monday Feb 15. It opens with Minnesota Timberwolves at Charlotte Hornets, LaMelo Ball's first game back in Charlotte since joining Minnesota. The other three games are 76ers vs. Lakers, Spurs vs. Heat and Pacers vs. Warriors; their home teams and tip times were not captured. All-Star Weekend is the following weekend, not on Presidents' Day weekend.

events.name: NBA All-Star 2027
events.location: Mortgage Matchup Center (formerly Footprint Center), Phoenix, AZ
events.notes: The 76th All-Star Game is on Sunday Feb 21, after Rising Stars on Friday Feb 19 and All-Star Saturday Night on Feb 20. All-Star Weekend airs on NBC/Peacock. This is Phoenix's fourth All-Star after 1975, 1995 and 2009. The arena took the Mortgage Matchup Center name in October 2025 under a 10-year, $115M naming deal with United Wholesale Mortgage, and the Suns are adding a large outdoor LED display ahead of the event. The format of the game itself (2026 used a USA-vs-World three-team round robin) was not verified.

events.name: Regular season ends
events.notes: Sunday Apr 11, 2027. The regular season runs from Oct 20, 2026 to Apr 11, 2027.

events.name: Play-In Tournament
events.notes: The SoFi NBA Play-In Tournament (seeds 7-10 in each conference) runs Tuesday to Friday, and Prime Video is the exclusive home of all six games.

events.name: NBA Playoffs begin
events.notes: One secondary guide reports Apr 18, 2027. The first round usually opens the Saturday after the Play-In, which would be Apr 17, and no official NBA release was found. Prime Video is the exclusive home of the 2027 Eastern Conference Finals.

events.name: NBA Finals
events.notes: Key-date coverage says only 'June'. A date-aggregator site lists Game 1 on Thursday 2027-06-03, which is unverified. ABC has carried the Finals under Disney's deal.

events.name: 2027 NBA Draft Lottery
events.notes: Not announced as of 2026-10-07. The lottery is normally held in mid-May during combine week.

events.name: 2027 NBA Draft Combine
events.notes: Not announced as of 2026-10-07. The combine has been held in Chicago in mid-May in recent years.

events.name: 2027 NBA Draft
events.notes: No official date or venue was found. A date-aggregator site lists 2027-06-24, which is unverified. For reference, the 2026 Draft was June 23-24, 2026 in a two-night format, and AJ Dybantsa was the No. 1 pick.

events.name: Free agency negotiating window opens
events.notes: Under the 2023 CBA, negotiations open on June 30 at 6 p.m. ET, and signings wait until the early-July moratorium ends. This is a CBA rule; no league release confirming the 2027 date was found.

events.name: Las Vegas Summer League 2027
events.location: Las Vegas, NV (Thomas & Mack Center / Cox Pavilion in recent years)
events.notes: Dates not announced. Naming caveat: 'NBA 2K27 Summer League' was the July 2026 edition (the title tracks the next 2K game), so July 2027 would be '2K28' if the deal continues.

events.name: Nike City Edition 2026-27 unveil
events.notes: No 2026-27 City Edition unveil date was found on 2026-10-07. City Editions have typically been unveiled in November around the NBA Cup window. The confirmed 2026 Nike jersey news is the Sept 9 'Specter' reveal, listed as its own event.

structural.fact: On 2026-10-07 this file was re-verified with 20 live web searches. Direct page fetches to nba.com, ESPN and NBC Sports were blocked, so facts were read from search-result summaries and cross-checked across outlets where possible. Only entries with status 'confirmed' were corroborated today. 'announced-tentative' means a CBA rule, a pattern or a single weak source, and 'not-announced' means no official date was found.

The New York Knicks are the reigning champions. They beat the San Antonio Spurs 4-1 in the 2026 NBA Finals (June 3-13, 2026), their first title since 1973, and Jalen Brunson was Finals MVP. The Spurs beat the Thunder in the 2026 West finals. Betting markets for 2026-27 favor the Spurs and Thunder, with the Knicks fourth.

structural.topic: 2026 offseason context surfaced during verification (not a full transactions list)
structural.fact: LeBron James is now with the Philadelphia 76ers; the Christmas, MLK Day and opening-night coverage all refer to him as a 76er. Dunkest also lists Jaylen Brown with Philadelphia (single source). LaMelo Ball now plays for the Minnesota Timberwolves. Giannis Antetokounmpo was the subject of 'the blockbuster trade of the offseason', with the Heat and Celtics among the bidders, but his destination was not captured here. Check team-level files for rosters.

2026-27 is year two of the 11-year national deals with Disney (ABC/ESPN), NBCUniversal (NBC/Peacock/NBCSN) and Amazon (Prime Video), and TNT is not a national game partner. NBC/Peacock carries 100 regular-season games, including late-December Holiday Hoops, the first-ever Presidents' Day quadrupleheader, the second MLK Day quadrupleheader, All-Star 2027 in Phoenix and playoff games. Prime Video streams 66 regular-season games plus the NBA Cup knockout rounds, all six Play-In games and the 2027 Eastern Conference Finals, all exclusively. ESPN/ABC has Christmas Day and the Finals on ABC. The weekly pattern is Monday on Peacock, Tuesday on NBC/Peacock, Wednesday on ESPN, Thursday on Prime, Friday on Prime and ESPN, Saturday on Prime (afternoon) and ABC (night), and Sunday on ABC (afternoon) and NBC/Peacock (night). The 76ers, Knicks and Spurs feature most heavily on national TV.

On March 25, 2026 the Board of Governors voted unanimously (30-0) to let the league explore expansion bids from Seattle and Las Vegas, with 2028-29 as the target entry season. Reported fees are $7-10B per team. A final expansion vote needs 23 of 30 governors, and no franchise has been awarded yet. After the September 2026 Board of Governors meeting, Adam Silver repeated the goal of deciding by the end of 2026, and reports say a Las Vegas decision may come before Seattle's. Some September 2026 coverage describes a further vote, but the details conflict and were not verified.

structural.topic: Emirates NBA Cup format and site
structural.fact: The fourth Emirates NBA Cup has six groups of five, seeded from the prior season's standings. Group play runs on Fridays from Oct 30 to Nov 27, plus Nov 24-25. Eight teams advance: the six group winners and the best second-place team per conference. The quarterfinals (Dec 4-5) and semifinals (Dec 8-9) are at the higher seed's home arena, and the championship is Dec 11 at Hinkle Fieldhouse in Indianapolis, the first time the final rounds are not in Las Vegas. Prime Video carries every knockout game.

The Phoenix Suns/Mercury arena has been the Mortgage Matchup Center since October 2025 (10-year, $115M naming deal with Suns owner Mat Ishbia's UWM), and it hosts All-Star 2027. No franchise relocation or new NBA arena opening for 2026-27 came up in this verification, though it was not searched for specifically.

In March 2025 the NBA and FIBA announced they are jointly exploring a new men's professional league in Europe. It is not part of the 2026-27 NBA season, and its launch timing, cities and teams were not re-verified on 2026-10-07.
